rv.q: Trinty Rep’s “The Getaway Driver” is a well-written, engrossing, artfully directed work of theater, featuring two stage veterans at their absolute best.
Their subscribers have no idea how fortunate they are.
Overall, this is a thought-provoking and intelligent play about two women whose lives were changed forever by one horrific event.

cn.t: Trinity Rep's true crime drama about Vietnam-era activist Katherine Ann Power earns strong praise for Rebecca Gibel's mesmerizing performance and its compelling exploration of moral complexity, though reception is solidly positive rather than ecstatic.
